title: Chapter 922
paragraphs: Chapter 922
Episode 230. Invasion and Raid (3)
"Has it been confirmed who attacked the Holy Kingdom?"
{The spies couldn't see the attackers directly. But there was a huge shock that shook the protective barrier of the Holy Kingdom, and it was assumed that the number wasn't that great.}
At the moment Kashimir answered, Jin felt a chill at the nape of his neck.
It felt as if a powerful enemy was exposing its murderous intent right in front of him. It was not just a feeling, but a real sensation that pricked his skin and rushed in fiercely.
From Groshi Castle to the Holy Kingdom, it takes more than half a day to fly exclusively on Murakan. Except for a star, no one can show their presence to an opponent at such a long distance.
'The First Sword of the Demon Realm, it must be him.'
Phaelito Belgasium.
Jin was sure that the person looking at him with murderous intent, jumping across vast space, was him.
Jin knew that Phaelito cherished Saki El. His most beloved subordinate was brutally killed, he must be burning with a desire for revenge.
"Got it. I'll contact you again."
{Master Jin, please be careful.}
"Yes, don't worry too much. After all, the enemy we have to fight just came to us a little faster than expected."
Jin put down the communicator.
"Murakan, Dante, Sir Hedo and I will go to the Holy Kingdom for support right away. The rest of the troops and superhumans will continue to protect the federation's territory and wait."
"Jin, wouldn't it be better if Luna and I also went with you?"
"You sisters should go to the Empire instead of Dante."
The Empire has the largest territory among the Vamel Federation. It would be more efficient for Luna and Luntia to go than for Dante alone to defend the Empire.

"Huphester, Tikan, and Hidden Palace are currently doing well in blocking the invasion, but the Empire seems to be a bit overpowered. We may need to send more knights from Runcandel, not just you sisters."
"That's true...but Jin, you must have felt it most strongly. Certainly, it's the star. And that murderous intent is aimed at you."
"Yes. This will be my first time fighting a star."
He had faced beings similar to the star, like Gliyak or the Atrocity. But it was his first time to fight to the death with a mortal who had ascended to the star.
Indeed, his mouth was dry for the first time in a long while. His whole body was trembling, pouring out a fighting spirit. He wanted to defeat Phaelito.
Jin took his sword.
"I'll sort out Luntia and the Empire as quickly as possible and then head to the Holy Kingdom."
"Heh, by the time you tough guys arrive, he's probably already gone to join his cherished subordinates. So just take care of our territories."
"Indeed, we should be worried about Murakan, not the youngest. The youngest will probably escape if it gets dangerous, but Murakan doesn't have that."
"What?"
"Youngest, please take good care of Murakan. He shouldn't get hurt because he overdid it due to his pride."
"Understood, Sister."
"Che, out of grief, I should quickly regain my remaining strength."
The party headed for the Red Owl's launch room.
Doctor Qwaul, who was setting the coordinates to the Holy Kingdom, looked gloomy.
"Chief, there's indeed an error."
"Error?"

"The Red Owl can't track the Holy Kingdom's wave. I suspected this when I heard that communications were blocked. Space jumps and communications both operate on wave tracking principles. No coordinates are coming up at all. Like that guy Tilius Bisex, he completely blocked communications and space jumps."

According to Tilius, the 'power of blocking' was only permitted to high-ranking demons originating from the immortal region of the Demon Realm, that is, Bisex. There were no demons on the list of Zito's subordinates that Tilius provided who used the power of blocking.
Jin immediately contacted the curtain to find Tilius, but he was not currently in place.
'There's no reason for Bisex or Tilius to stab us in the back at this point. Probably, they've blocked space jumps and communications with some method unknown to Tilius.'
The more Qwaul touched the Red Owl, the darker his face became.
"Darn it, I'm trying to set the coordinates to a place relatively close to the Holy Kingdom, but even that's not working well. There's a heavy overload."
"Is it too much to move with the Red Owl?"

"Yes. Even if we manage to grab a nearby coordinate and make a space jump, the Red Owl will have issues right away. In my opinion, it seems best to move as close as possible through the Mort, then go in by flight."
Syris immediately summoned the Mort.
[Boing!]
The Mort also failed to open a direct dimensional gate to the Holy Kingdom. However, unlike the Red Owl, it didn't seem exhausted by just opening the gate.
"Let's go, Jin. I'll ask Mort to gradually narrow the distance to the Holy Kingdom."
The party climbed onto Mort's back.
Soon, Mort started to run after opening a new dimensional gate to the different world. Jin noticed that the back of Syris touching his chest was trembling slightly.
"Tararis is the one I'm concerned about. Although his body has recovered significantly, Tararis has had to endure the gaze of Zito from the Holy Kingdom up to now.
He's in a state where he can't fight at his full strength. Moreover, the attack this time could possibly have caused Zito's eyes to rampage.
"I will definitely save Lord Tararis. Even if it costs me my life."
Syris flinches.
"... It's a kind thought. But your life has become too precious to be sacrificed for anyone."
"It's not too much to use for Lord Tararis. After all, I've received so much grace from him that I can't repay it no matter how much I try."

"Mother, the leader of the army is strong. Even if the one who attacked the Holy Kingdom this time is Chiron Kyeong, he will not be easily defeated. Plus, there's the protection barrier set up by Lady Ayula. I appreciate your feelings, truly."
Syris sincerely thought that Jin shouldn't die for Tararis.
Because it was the right thing to do in order to fulfill the mission of protecting the world as the army leader.

"Of course, since our opponent is Genesis, we have no choice but to fight risking our lives. But I believe in you. No matter how strong the enemy is, I believe you can win. So I'm not extremely anxious about the current situation. You are the only one who can give me this kind of faith in such a situation, Jin."
Already, the gate to the other world has been opened and closed several times.
As they approached a point close to the Holy Kingdom, a dense magical energy was pressuring the group. It was the magic emitted by the invaders.

The group was reminded of the time when Gliyak or Hyungshin spread the spirit of chaos into the world. If Phaelito continues to emit magic like this, they thought that eventually the entire world would be covered.
The magic chased after Mort even to the other world each time the gate opened. Due to the special state of space leap, it was impossible to perfectly block the magic with a protection barrier.
[Boooooooook...!]
Mort's breath was becoming rough. If they continued to go in like this, there was no doubt that Mort would get hurt.
"Jin, let's stop moving with Mort here. At this point, we can reach the Holy Kingdom within an hour if we ride on Murakan."
After escaping from the other world two more times, Syris spoke.

"Now even the Ice Princess looks down on me. An hour? I'll get there in thirty minutes. This so-called magic can't slow me down. But still, wouldn't it be better for Lord Mort to suffer a little more? Then we'll arrive in 5 minutes."

"If we go further, Mort will get hurt enough to need a rest for a while. Then during that time, we'll have to move the superhumans only with the Red Owl, increasing the likelihood that we can't respond to the enemy's invasion as well as we do now."
"Syris, sir."

"Listen to me. Honestly, I want to go further in somehow and support my mother as quickly as possible, but you have to make a choice for the whole. You're usually more cool-headed than anyone I know, but you tend to rush in like a fireball at times like this. That's why everyone trusts and likes you as a colleague."
Thump, Syris gently tapped Jin's shoulder with his fist.

"Go and protect the kingdom. As always, prevent the enemies from achieving what they want. We will go back now. And Murakan, please stop using that nickname 'Ice Princess'. It gives me chills every time I hear it."
Please take care of Mother, please save her somehow.
Syris disappeared into the portal to the other world without saying those words in the end.
Jin, and all his companions understood why Syris had acted in that manner.
[The Ice Princess has grown a lot. She seems more mature than you, kid.]
Murakan transformed and spoke while carrying his companions on his back.
"...... I admire the Fire Princess. If Grandfather, who has returned to the kingdom now, were here, I don't think I would have been as bold as the Fire Princess."
"If it were me, Sandra, I wouldn't have been able to do that either. In some ways, among all of us gathered here, the Fire Princess is the strongest."
[So, we should never make our Ice Princess sad. We're taking off. We'll break through without a shield in 30 minutes, so everyone, take care of your magic energy.]
Flap-!
Murakan spread his two pairs of wings. A surprisingly fast flight followed, given his huge size.
No matter how great Phaelito's magic power was, it couldn't threaten the four of them. The onslaught of magic power was just bothersome at most.
The real problem was the killing intent.
A sharp killing intent that seemed to cut through his entire body if he lost his focus for even a moment was fiercely pouring onto Jin.
The fight between Jin and Phaelito had already started a while ago. Jin was calmly concentrating his mind and removing the invisible killing intent one by one.

Murakan indeed reached the sea, where the protection of Ayula, enveloping the kingdom, could be seen, in exactly 30 minutes. However, due to the heavy magical fog, only the outline could barely be seen.
But the protection was clearly recognizable, even if it was blurry.

[Fortunately, the protective barrier set by Ayula is not completely lost. After all, it was expanded using a divine tool by him. Even if it's a spearhead, it's difficult to penetrate... damn, what's that hole!]
There was a huge crack in one side of the protective barrier. As they hurriedly approached, they could see the back of Phaelito, who was about to enter the kingdom's airspace.
He had sensed the arrival of the group in the kingdom and deliberately paused and waited. And below Phaelito, another protective barrier unfolded by Talaris to block him could be seen.
"You've come... Jin Runcandel."
Phaelito's dark voice could be heard.
